items.label: What does KassenBoost do?
items.text: KassenBoost shows you, free and without contact details, which health fund gives you more in contributions, bonus and benefits.

items.label: What does Healio do?
items.text: Healio advises you on suitable outpatient, dental or hospital cover and checks whether your fund bonus can offset part of the premium.

items.label: What do I pay and handle myself?
items.text: You pay the insurance premium yourself. You apply for the bonus or subsidy at your health fund with your own proof.

paths.title: How would you like to continue?

bonus.title: How your bonus can offset the premium.
bonus.description: You pay the insurance premium yourself. Your health fund pays the earned cash bonus or reimburses an earmarked subsidy under its rules. There is no automatic offset against the insurance premium.
bonus.exampleLabel: Verified example, IKK classic, bonus year 2026
bonus.example: Suppose you earn 100 EUR in cash or, alternatively, a 300 EUR earmarked subsidy. At an assumed premium of 25 EUR per month, your cover costs 300 EUR a year. The cash bonus offsets 100 EUR, leaving you to pay 200 EUR. The subsidy may offset the full 300 EUR if your premium is eligible and you provide proof of costs.
bonus.note: Illustration only, not a policy offer or guaranteed bonus. Cash and subsidy are alternatives and cannot be added together. Activities, eligible costs and conditions depend on the fund and bonus year; reimbursement cannot exceed proven expenses.

transparency: Advice and brokerage are free for you. If you sign a policy, the insurer pays Healio a commission.
The KassenBoost comparison stays separate. No ranking there is influenced by commission.
You decide freely. No call obliges you to anything.

employer.title: Access for employees. No insight for the employer.
employer.description: Employers can offer KassenBoost voluntarily as orientation. Individual entries, results and decisions stay private. Healio designs company benefits separately from that.

items.question: Do I have to switch health funds?
items.answer: No. You can choose supplementary cover while staying with your current health fund. Any bonus or subsidy depends on its programme and your documented activities.

items.question: What if my bonus is less than the premium?
items.answer: You pay the remaining amount yourself. You owe the insurer the full premium regardless of any bonus. Bonuses are not guaranteed and are not automatically offset against insurance premiums.

items.question: What do KassenBoost and Healio each do?
items.answer: KassenBoost provides the health fund comparison. Healio is the brokerage behind it and advises on and brokers supplementary insurance. Advice and brokerage are free for you; if you sign a policy, the insurer pays Healio a commission. The comparison and its ranking remain separate.

items.question: Does Healio receive my comparison details?
items.answer: No, details from the KassenBoost comparison are not transferred to Healio automatically. You decide what to share for advice. Employers do not receive individual comparison entries, results or decisions.
